title: Hybrid mechanistic-machine learning PK/PD models with digital biomarkers: from cage to clinic

content.abstract_summary: A review of hybrid mechanistic-ML PK/PD modeling focused on digital biomarker integration. Surveys model architectures, covariate discovery, cross-species scaling, and validation for preclinical-to-clinical extrapolation (2015–2025 literature). Concludes that model credibility depends on validation rigor and regulatory alignment, not algorithmic novelty.
key_findings: Hybrid approaches improve clearance estimation, covariate discovery, and cross-species scaling when the mechanistic model is structurally sound but parametrically under-identified
Adding an ML layer risks overfitting without measurable gain when mechanistic models already fit well and sample sizes are small
Integration of multimodal (digital biomarker) datasets introduces challenges: missing data, device drift, and data leakage requiring explicit mitigation
Credibility depends on validation rigor, interpretability, and regulatory alignment rather than algorithmic novelty
Reporting and audit practices are needed to support robustness, reproducibility, and regulatory review
limitations: Only abstract read; extracted claims may not capture nuance from the Methods or Results sections
Narrative (non-systematic) review; search protocol and inclusion criteria not described in abstract — potential selection bias
No quantitative synthesis of hybrid model performance across studies; conclusions are qualitative

extracted_claims.text: "The credibility of hybrid models depends on validation rigor, interpretability, and regulatory alignment rather than on algorithmic novelty."
"When mechanistic models fit well and sample sizes are small, adding an ML layer risks overfitting without measurable gain."
"Models that are prospectively tested, transparently documented, and fitted to a defined context of use will be more influential than those that are merely complex."

numerical_findings.description: Publication date range covered by the review

gaps_addressed: No mathematical criteria for when hybrid models add value over purely mechanistic models
Lack of validation and benchmarking standards for hybrid PK/PD models
FDA credibility framework not yet operationalized for hybrid ML-mechanistic pharmacometric models
